Is a damaged item handled differently from a normal return?

Yes, a damaged item is handled differently from a standard return. For damage, I can help with a replacement or refund review instead of sending you through the regular return flow. I’ll just need your order number or checkout email, plus a clear photo of the damage. If the issue is an unusual odor, photos are not required. ✨

Do you need photos, and where do I send them?

Yes, for most damaged item claims I do need a clear photo before I can move forward with a replacement or refund. You can send the photo right here in the chat.

The one exception is if the issue is a strong chemical or unusual odor, then photos are not required.

Once you send the photo, please include your order number or the email used at checkout so I can help with the next step. ✨

Will I get a replacement or a refund?

Usually, if the damage is confirmed, I can help with a replacement if the item is available. If it’s out of stock, or if you prefer not to receive a replacement, I can help with a refund instead. For most damage claims, I’ll need a clear photo first, and you can send it right here in the chat. Once you share the photo plus your order number or checkout email, I can help with the next step. ✨

Do I have to pay anything to return the damaged item?

No, you should not have to pay a return fee for a damaged item claim. Damaged items are handled outside the standard return process, and in many approved cases you won’t need to send the item back at all. If you send me your order number or checkout email, plus a clear photo of the damage here in chat, I can help with the next step right away. ✨

How long does the replacement take?

Once a replacement is approved, it begins processing on business days, Monday through Friday. Orders placed into processing after 12 PM EST start the next business day.

As soon as the replacement ships, you’ll receive tracking so you can follow it from there. If you want, send me your order number or checkout email and I can help with the damaged item claim here. ✨

If more than one item in your order is affected, I can review each damaged item as part of the same claim. Please send a clear photo of each affected item here in the chat, along with your order number or the email used at checkout, and I’ll take it from there. If any of the items have a strong chemical or unusual odor, photos are not required for those. ✨

If the issue is an unusual odor, photos are not required. ✨

Typically, replacement orders ship with the same shipping method as the original order, they are not automatically upgraded to priority. Once the replacement is approved and created, it follows our normal business-day processing timeline, and you’ll get tracking as soon as it ships. ✨
